evidence.heading: Accessibility and Special Requirements
evidence.text: Is Allas Live accessible? Allas Live is accessible. The outdoor venue includes wooden decked pathways that are easy to move along. However, most of the ground surface is sand and grass, so please take this into account in advance. A dedicated area is reserved for wheelchair users, and we recommend that guests using rollators stay close to this area. There is an accessible viewing platform at the venue, and an accessible toilet is located nearby. If your mobility aid needs electricity or you have other special requirements during the concert, please contact production@allaslive.fi well in advance. Personal assistants can attend concerts free of charge, but they must have a companion ticket. The companion ticket can be redeemed when purchasing the ticket. How do accessible taxi drop-off and accessible parking work? An accessible taxi can stop near the Allas Live area. There is no dedicated accessible parking at the venue. More information about parking options in Katajanokka can be found on the City of Helsinki website. Are there seats at the concert? Regular Allas Live concert tickets are standing tickets and do not include a reserved seat. Unfortunately, we cannot guarantee or reserve a seat in advance. We recommend arriving at the venue in good time.

evidence.heading: ACCESSIBILITY
evidence.text: Accessible/Disabled seating is available on the lower level of the arena. Wheelchair area is located behind sections 113 and 116 (depending on event set-up behind sections 105 and 108 may also be available). Wheelchairs must purchase a ticket to these areas only. There is no access to main floor or other seating areas. If you can walk with assistance tickets can be purchased in any section but wheelchair can’t be stored at or near your seat. Tickets for accessible seating areas are available through Ticketmaster and the Allstate Arena Box Office. When ordering tickets for an accessible seating area, it is important to indicate that you require accessible seating so we can properly seat you. Please note that the number of seats available in the accessible seating area meets the requirements of the Americans With Disabilities Act (ADA) and other laws relating to accessibility, however, the number of seats in the accessible seating areas is limited. Tickets for seats in the accessible seating areas are sold on a first come, first served basis.

evidence.heading: Is the itinerary accessible for people with disabilities?
evidence.text: Yes. In December 2016, the Archaeological Park opened ‘Pompeii for All’, an itinerary specifically designed for disabled visitors to Italy’s longest accessible pathway through an archaeological site.

evidence.heading: Pompeii digital magazine. While excavation is in progress, information is already going online
evidence.text: "The internet is changing the way we live, and archaeology cannot escape this transformation," says Director Zuchtriegel, "now our task is to manage the digital transformation proactively in order to develop its enormous potential. Through the E-Journal and our platform open.pompeiisites.org, we can achieve a level of data accessibility that was unimaginable in the past, and we can share data almost in real time. All this will change the way of doing archaeology: we are moving towards a model of collective and connective knowledge, supported in the future by Artificial Intelligence tools, which, as the Minister of Culture, Gennaro Sangiuliano, said, must be granted and mastered. Pompeii confirms itself at the forefront of 21st century archaeology."

evidence.heading: Visitor services
evidence.text: The bookshop service is active at the entrance to Piazza Esedra, Piazza Anfiteatro and at Antiquarium. Here visitors can broaden their knowledge of the history of the ancient city, with many scientific and non-specialist publications, as well as catalogues.

evidence.heading: Visitor services
evidence.text: Authorised audio guides are in service inside the site and are available at the Porta Marina entrance, Piazza Esedra and Porta Anfiteatro entrance.

evidence.heading: Visitor services
evidence.text: LUGGAGE STORAGE Luggage storage services are available for a fee at the Porta Marina and Piazza Anfiteatro entrances. Visitors and all interested parties (schools, tour operators, tour guides, etc.) are informed that, to protect the frescoes and the interiors of the archaeological areas under the jurisdiction of this Archaeological Park and to ensure everyone’s safety, effective January 15, 2015, it is NOT PERMITTED to bring bags, backpacks, luggage, or cases larger than 30x30x15 cm into the excavations of Pompeii, Oplontis, Stabiae, and the Boscoreale Antiquarium.

evidence.heading: Visitor services
evidence.text: There are three Baby Changing Facilities in three locations of the ancient city: in Via dell’Abbondanza, Via di Nola, and at the corner of Via Stabiana and Via della Fortuna. These facilities, like other services and facilities offered by the Archaeological Park, aim at granting visitors a more comfortable visit and meeting their needs. Another such example is the ‘Pompeii for All’ project with accessible and barrier-free paths providing improved access to the site to parents with buggies and mobility-impaired people.

evidence.heading: Visitor services
evidence.text: The Archaeological Park toilet facilities are located near the access points of Piazza Anfiteatro, Piazza Esedra and Porta Marina, near the Casina dell’Aquila, the Antiquarium, Quadriportico, the Villa of the Mysteries and before the entrance to the Antiquarium below the Temple of Venus.

You can also head to our kiosks open during the events to buy or pick up your tickets. These are located around the venue near to the main entrance of the halls. What's On What are Booking Fees? evidence.text: Drop-off and pick-up locations are located along 10th Street , on the west side of the facility, near the Arena and Convention Center entrances.

evidence.heading: Box Office
evidence.text: The CHI Health Center Omaha Box Office is located inside the west entrance of the Arena along 10th Street. It is open Monday through Friday from 10 AM to 5 PM. The Box Office is closed on weekends unless there is a ticketed event, or tickets are going on sale to the public.

Accessible Parking Accessible parking is available in the connecting parking garage and surrounding surface lots at CHI Health Center Omaha. Key details include: • Accessible spaces, including van-accessible stalls, are designated for vehicles displaying a current state-issued hangtag or license plate. • Drop-off and pick-up locations are located along 10th Street, on the west side of the facility, near the Arena and Convention Center entrances. • Guests parking in Lot A (southeast side of the Arena) may use the curb cut within the lot for drop-off and pick-up. Please note, accessible spaces are available on a first-come, first-served basis, so we recommend planning accordingly. Please refer to the Directions/Parking section of our website for more information.

Box Office The CHI Health Center Omaha Box Office is located inside the west entrance of the Arena along 10th Street. It is open Monday through Friday from 10 AM to 5 PM. The Box Office is closed on weekends unless there is a ticketed event, or tickets are going on sale to the public. The Box Office opens at least two hours prior to any ticketed event in the Arena. Accepted payment methods include Visa, MasterCard, Discover and American Express. Cash and checks are not accepted. All tickets are delivered digitally via Mobile Delivery, unless otherwise specified. A phone number or email address is required for all Box Office ticket purchases. Mobile tickets purchased at the Box Office can be easily accessed and added to your Ticketmaster account. For your convenience, free ten-minute parking for ticket purchases is available on a first-come, first-served basis in the curbside pull-off along 10th Street on the west side of the Arena.

Wheelchair Escorts Complimentary wheelchair escorts are available on a first-come, first-served basis for guests who require assistance during CHI Health Center Omaha Arena events. Please note that wheelchair assistance may not be offered during Convention Center events. A wheelchair attendant will meet guests at the entrance and provide an escort to their seat. After the event, the attendant may return with the wheelchair and assist the guest back to the exit. To request a wheelchair escort for an event, please alert security personnel upon arrival. We are happy to help ensure a comfortable and accessible experience for all of our guests.

evidence.text: FIRE MARSHAL REGULATIONS In accordance with the Clark County Uniform Fire Code, any gathering of 300 or more persons for a specific event requires a Fire Marshal-approved diagram on the premises for and during each event. In addition, separate permits are required for candles, open flames, pyrotechnics, vehicle displays, and trade show booths. Contractors/vendors are required to review current Fire Marshal regulations and restrictions for any items being brought in or built on the show floor. Additionally, all current ADA guidelines must be reviewed and followed for both seeing and mobility-impaired persons. Encore Global Productions can assist with creating and submitting the required diagrams and forms for an additional fee and must be requested no later than sixty (60) days in advance. If a third party contractor/vendor is submitting diagrams on the Group’s behalf, please contact your Encore Representative or Event Manager for additional details and information needed for submission. Additional information about Fire Marshal regulations, trade shows, and exhibit requirements can be found at the Clark County Fire Prevention Website. 11

evidence.text: Access to Ford Field parking facilities is generally four hours prior to kick-off. Vehicles will be directed into spaces and reserving spaces is not allowed. Tailgating and re-entry access is prohibited in parking facilities adjacent to Ford Field.

FORD FIELD ACCESSIBILITY SERVICES Ford Field takes pride in ensuring our events are enjoyable for all fans. Please review our accessibility services below. Please note for certain events, reasonable advance notice of certain accessibility services may be recommended and/or required. Please email guest.services@lions.nfl.net to let us know about any accommodations that may be needed during your visit to Ford Field or if you have any additional questions.

Accessible Drop-off/Pick-up Area Located near the intersection of Brush St. & Montcalm St. just northwest of Ford Field, outside Gates B & C. Please follow the directions of traffic directors & police officers. Street closures may impact this area.

Accessible Parking Accessible parking is available on game and event days in Lot 4 (on Montcalm St. located just north of Ford Field and east of Brush Street) and the Ford Field Parking Deck (on St. Antoine St. off Madison). Spots are available on a first-come, first- serve basis to our guests with the appropriate ADA permit and a state-issued license plate or placard. Parking facilities are ADA compliant. Guests needing assistance can enter through most Ford Field gates and may utilize any passenger elevator.

Accessible Seating Ford Field provides wheelchair accessible and companion seating for guests needing assistance. The accessible seating areas are located at the top of certain sections on the lower and upper concourses. On a ticket, row “ADA” stands for the wheelchair row at the top of the section. Please contact the usher if a folding chair is needed for the accessible space if a guest does not use a wheelchair or scooter.

Accessible Seat Relocation On game or event day, if a guest needing mobility assistance does not have accessible or wheelchair seating, their tickets may be exchanged inside of Ford Field at the Advance Ticket Windows at Gate A located on the side of the escalators by Section 100 or Gate G located next to the escalators by Section 112. Guests should first visit the nearest Guest Services location to fill out a seat relocation form. Ticket exchange is based upon availability and may be limited to the guest(s) that require ADA seating plus one (1) companion. Pending availability, larger parties may be accommodated with other non- accessible seats near the accessible row. Please contact the nearest Guest Services or Box Office representative for questions.

Accessible Seat Relocation On game or event day, if a guest needing mobility assistance does not have accessible or wheelchair seating, their tickets may be exchanged inside of Ford Field at the Advance Ticket Windows at Gate A located on the side of the escalators by Section 100 or Gate G located next to the escalators by Section 112. Guests should first visit the nearest Guest Services location to fill out a seat relocation form. Ticket exchange is based upon availability and may be limited to the guest(s) that require ADA seating plus one (1) companion. Pending availability, larger parties may be accommodated with other non- accessible seats near the accessible row. Please contact the nearest Guest Services or Box Office representative for questions.

Accessible seat relocation may be available in advance, depending on ticket purchase source, event and availability. Please email guest.services@lions.nfl.net at least one week in advance of game or event day.
Concessions & Merchandise Most concession and merchandise stands at Ford Field are accessible to guests needing assistance.

Elevators There are five areas of passenger elevators inside Ford Field. Elevators to access various stadium levels are located near: Section 104 & Level 2 near Blitz: South Side Levels 1 – 6, UMCU South Suites, Delta Club Level, Loge Boxes, Suites C1 – C8 Section 111 & Level 2 near Gate G Bridge: South Side Levels 1 – 6, UMCU South Suites, Delta Club Level, Loge Boxes, Suites C1 – C8 Section 128 & 230: Levels 1 – 2 Section 129 by Gate D & 232 inside Comerica Gridiron Club Level 2: North Side Levels 1 – 5, Comerica Gridiron Club Levels 2 – 3, Comerica Gridiron Suites (GS), Plante Moran Terrace Suites (TS), Miller Lite Taproom (MLTR) Section 133 & 235: Levels 1 – 2

Entry Gates Gates A, B, C, D, and G are equipped with accessible security lanes designated by a blue ADA sign. Please note that lines at the gates may extend past the accessible lane. Should you need accessible assistance entering the stadium, you may approach the accessible lane regardless of other lines. Please note that there will be a security inspection, and depending on accessibility needs may include walk through weapons or metal detectors, metal detecting hand wand, or physical pat down. In order to assist you in the most comfortable and efficient way possible, staff may ask certain questions before or during the inspection process. Should you have any questions, please feel free to ask staff or request to speak to a supervisor.

Guest Service Desk Locations Guest Service Desks are available at Gate A (Section 100/141), Gate B (Section 133), Gate C (Section 235), Gate E (Section 224), Gate G (Section 112), Level 2 of the Comerica Gridiron Club (Section 232) and near the elevators on Level 3 of the Delta Club Level. Please note that the available Guest Service Desks are subject to change based on the event.

evidence.heading: What is the camera policy?
evidence.text: Camera policies for professional productions Video recording devices are strictly prohibited during all professional productions. Simple cameras for personal use may be brought into the venue, as long as the following guidelines are adhered to: Simple cameras are defined as still photograph cameras that do not have detachable lenses, or cameras with an attached lenses of less than 2.5" x 3.0". Cell phone cameras are permitted, however, video recording using a cell phone camera is not allowed. Tripods and monopods are prohibited. Please be courteous to those guests around you when taking pictures. Cameras and cases are subject to search upon entering the venue. The official camera policy may be modified based upon the requests of artists/performers. On show days, the camera policy will be advertised on signs at the entrances to the venue. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVS)/Drone Policy To ensure the safety and enjoyment of all our guests, the Hershey Entertainment Complex strictly prohibits the operation of or use of any unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), commonly known as "Drones," on, from, or above the Hershey Entertainment Complex premises without specific written permission from an official of Hershey Entertainment & Resorts. This includes all UAVs regardless of size, weight, or purpose.

evidence.heading: VIP ENTRANCE
evidence.text: Beginning for the Friday, March 4 performance, Heritage Bank Center premium seat and suite holders will now have their own exclusive entrance into the facility. Located on the Northeast corner of the venue, the VIP Entrance will allow expedited entry. Doors will open at the same time as regular admittance for contemporary events but you will now be able to enter 15 minutes early for Cyclones games. As you will only have access to this entrance, your tickets will still be accepted at all other gates into Heritage Bank Center as well. Also, please be sure to make note and make your clients, employees, and friends aware of the bag policy that was instituted in October 2021.

evidence.heading: VIP ENTRANCE
evidence.text: Please understand that we will be monitoring the new VIP Entrance and ensuring that we can provide the most efficient entry that you have ever experienced at Heritage Bank Center. There are many moving parts within this new venture, so please be patient with our staff. Beginning with your April monthly tickets that will be sent later this month, we will identify your VIP access with an exclusive identifying ticket stock that will allow for seamless entry. We will keep you up to speed with that application. For now, please enjoy your new amenity as your tickets have been coded for entry beginning with Friday’s Katt Williams’ performance! Thank you for your patience and support as we attempt to enhance your VIP Experience at Heritage Bank Center!

evidence.heading: Accessible Parking
evidence.text: A visible state-issued plate or placard is required to use an accessible parking spot. Guests needing assistance who do not have a placard will need to use general parking. Accessible parking is subject to availability and first come, first served. First Financial Credit Union Amphitheater honors any state-issued accessible parking placard for a vehicle that fits in a 9'x18' parking space without impeding the people on either side of the vehicle. Oversized vehicles with a parking placard will not be allowed to park in an accessible parking space. Vehicles that park in an accessible parking spot without a valid state issued placard are subject to tow at the owners expense. Due to high demand, accessible parking availability is limited and spaces may fill early. We recommend arriving when the parking gates open if you plan to use accessible parking. evidence.heading: Accessible Parking
evidence.text: Upon arrival on event day, inform staff you need accessible parking. A visible state-issued plate or placard with matching ID is required to use an accessible parking spot. Guests needing assistance who do not have a placard will need to drop off guests in the accessible parking lot and use general parking. Accessible parking is subject to availability and is first-come, first-served. Jiffy Lube Live honors any state-issued accessible parking placard for a vehicle that fits in a 9’ x 18’ parking space without impeding the people on either side of your vehicle. Oversized vehicles (e.g. stretch limos, RVs, buses, etc.) with a disabled parking placard will not be allowed to park in an accessible parking space. To ensure you can park as close as possible, we recommend arriving when the parking gates open.

evidence.heading: Visites
evidence.text: Plongez dans les entrailles du Stade à la découverte de son histoire riche d’innombrables exploits sportifs, de concerts mythiques et de shows spectaculaires. Le temps d’une visite, glissez-vous dans la peau de Kevin De Bruyne, d’Usain Bolt ou de Beyoncé et vivez l’expérience Stade Roi Baudouin depuis les backstage . Découvrez les salles de presse, le vestiaire des Diables Rouges, une loge d’artiste, le tunnel des joueurs, en vous laissant conter multitude d’anecdotes par nos guides spécialisés. Au bord du terrain, ressentez l’émotion d’un joueur foulant la pelouse pour la première fois, frissonnez en revivant les records mondiaux établis sur la piste d’athlétisme, vibrez en imaginant les gradins se remplir et reprendre vos chansons à l’unisson. Une immersion complète dans les coulisses du Stade Roi Baudouin et ses espaces insolites qui restera, à coup sûr, gravée dans votre mémoire à jamais.

evidence.heading: Visits
evidence.text: Journey deep into the heart of the stadium and discover its rich history of sporting exploits, legendary concerts and spectacular shows. Slip into the shoes of Kevin De Bruyne, Usain Bolt or Beyoncé and experience the King Baudouin Stadium from backstage . Discover the press area, the Red Devil’s dressing room, an artist’s dressing room and the players’ tunnel, whilst listening to the anecdotes told by our expert guides. At the edge of the playing field, feel the emotion of a player stepping out onto the pitch for the first time, embrace the excitement as you relive the world records set on the athletics track and experience the thrill as you imagine crowds filling the stands and singing your songs together with fellow spectators. A complete behind-the-scenes tour of the King Baudouin Stadium and its restricted-access areas will leave you memories that will last a lifetime.

evidence.heading: Bezoeken
evidence.text: Duik in de onderbuik van het stadion en ontdek de rijke geschiedenis van de vele sportprestaties, legendarische concerten en spectaculaire shows. Kruip in de huid van Kevin De Bruyne, Usain Bolt of Beyoncé en beleef het Koning Boudewijnstadion van achter de schermen . Ontdek de persruimten, de kleedkamer van de Rode Duivels, een artiestenloge en de spelerstunnel, en luister naar vele anekdotes van onze deskundige gidsen. Voel de emotie van een speler die voor het eerst het veld betreedt, herbeleef de wereldrecords die op de atletiekpiste werden neergezet en stel je voor hoe de tribunes volstromen en jouw liedjes uit volle borst meezingen. Een echte onderdompeling achter de schermen van het Koning Boudewijnstadion en zijn ongewone plekjes, die je gegarandeerd voor altijd bijblijft.

evidence.heading: Persons under 18 years of age
evidence.text: Events hosted by PROGRESJA are open for all people over 12 years old (with exception of those dedicated especially for kids and teens). Minors may enter the club with a written consent of their legal guardian ( FORM ), unless the club states otherwise at a specific event. Information regarding parental consent for a minor to attend a concert organized by Progresja is necessary for us to ensure the safety of event participants. We require that the child have a completed and signed consent form by their legal guardian, using the form available on our website, and we verify this during ticket inspection at the entrance to the concert. However, we DO NOT COLLECT, STORE, or PROCESS these forms or the personal data contained therein. We only want to ensure that the minor is participating in the event with the consent of their guardian, and we can contact them if necessary.This information applies to concerts organized by Progresja. In the case of events organized by other organizers, they may have separate policies in this regard.

evidence.heading: FAQs
evidence.text: Little Caesars Arena, the Fox Theatre, Pine Knob Music Theatre, Meadow Brook Amphitheatre, Michigan Lottery Amphitheatre and Fifth Third Park have partnered with and gained certification with KultureCity, making all events hosted at the venues sensory inclusive. This initiative promotes an accommodating and positive experience for all guests with sensory needs.

evidence.heading: FAQs
evidence.text: Event staff are trained by leading medical professionals on how to recognize guests with sensory needs and how to best handle a sensory overload situation. Sensory bags, equipped with noise canceling headphones, fidget tools, verbal cue cards and weighted lap pads are available to all guests who may feel overwhelmed by the environment. Guests will also have access to sensory areas for those who may need a quieter and more secure environment. Sensory bags may be checked out at Guest Services at each venue the day or night of an event.

evidence.heading: What are the security procedures?
evidence.text: Security Employees and third-part contracted partners of Mohegan Arena at Casey Plaza reserve the right to inspect and search all guests entering the Arena. The Mohegan Arena at Casey Plaza reserves the right to employ metal detection devices as necessary to promote a safe environment for guests, performers and employees. Guests entering the Arena for an event must enter through the West or East Gate, where guests will walk pass through outdoor metal detectors or may request a manual pat-down as warranted. Media personnel must enter through a designated press entrance at the West Gate. Security Reminders: Walk-through metal detectors will be in place at every arena entrance. No outside food or beverage is permitted inside the venue (exceptions may be made for medical/dietary restrictions). Guests are asked to have their keys, wallets and phones out of their pockets upon arrival at the security checkpoints and jackets should be unzipped. Strollers/car seats are not permitted. No signs, face or body paint, or noisemakers/horns/permitted. If you have any questions about these policies, please email the venue at questions@MoheganArenaPA.com . Please visit our "Bag Policy" tab for information on our clear bag policy.

evidence.heading: Security
evidence.text: For your own safety, we carry out bag checks at the entrance. We ask you not to bring large handbags or rucksacks into the myticket Jahrhunderthalle, as this will delay admission times. At some events it is not permitted to bring bags larger than A4. The following items are prohibited: - Weapons or dangerous objects that could cause bodily injury if thrown - Aerosol spray bottles, corrosive or colouring substances, pressurised containers for highly flammable or harmful gases (excluding commercially available pocket lighters and hairspray) and breakable container - Mechanically or electronically operated acoustic devices - All food and drinks brought in from outside - Animals (except guide dogs and assistance dogs) - Racist, xenophobic and radical propaganda materials - Sound and image recording devices for commercial use

evidence.heading: Parking Map
evidence.text: Vehicle entrances for the Nationals parking garages and lots are as follows:

evidence.heading: A
evidence.text: Accommodations/Guest Services In addition to those listed in this Guide, the Washington Nationals offer readily available accommodations for guests with disabilities and special needs. Our Nationals Guest Experience team has three locations available to serve our guests, located in Centerfield Plaza, and behind Sections 131 and 320. All Guest Services locations will be open when gates open. Guest Services located in Centerfield Plaza will remain open an additional 45 minutes following the conclusion of the game.

evidence.heading: A
evidence.text: Autographs Two Nationals players will sign autographs for fans at Sunday home games, starting one hour before first pitch at the top of the Nationals dugout (weather permitting and subject to player schedules). To participate, fans must obtain a free voucher, distributed at Section 103 on a first-come, first-served basis when gates open (80 minutes before first pitch). Fans are limited to one voucher per person. Redemption of vouchers is subject to the rules and policies of the Washington Nationals, each of which may change from time to time.

evidence.heading: B
evidence.text: Batting Practice Guests are invited to watch batting practice upon the opening of gates. All gates will open 80 minutes prior to first pitch (75 minutes for 6:45pm games). Batting practice times are approximate and subject to change without prior notification and at the discretion of either team. Guests may not watch batting practice from a seating area where they do not have a valid ticket entitlement.

evidence.heading: B
evidence.text: Bike Valet Nationals Park is bicycle friendly, with space for 250 bikes in bike racks located around the exterior of the ballpark. Guests may use the free Bicycle Valet, located to the left of the entrance to Garage C, on First Street SE near N Street SE. The valet accepts bikes, personal e-scooters and e-bikes once gates open and will close 45 minutes after the completion of the game. Guests may also check their helmets as helmets are not permitted in Nationals Park. Guests can determine the best bike route by visiting nationals.com/waytogo . Bicycles are not permitted inside Nationals Park.

evidence.heading: B
evidence.text: Home Plate Box Office next to the Home Plate Gate is open beginning when gates open and closes at the end of the 3rd inning.

evidence.heading: B

evidence.heading: Accessibility Info
evidence.text: Complimentary wheelchair escorts are available upon request at any entry point of Nationwide Arena - arrangements do not need to be made in advance. The escort will take guests as close as possible to their seat and coordinate pick up after the event. Escort staff will not remain with you or allow you to remain in our wheelchair for the duration of the event. Service Animals as defined by the American Disabilities Association are the only animals permitted in Nationwide Arena. Complete information about accessibility services including sign interpretation, arena access, purchasing accessible tickets, wheelchair companion seating and accessible parking can be found on the Accessibility Page .

evidence.heading: CLICK HERE for details.
evidence.text: The number of accessible parking spaces near Nationwide Arena exceeds ADA standards. Surrounding lots and garages offer accessible (w/ state-issued disability-parking hangtag) spaces. Demand for accessible parking at heavily attended events may exceed the available supply. Options suggested : North entrance of the McConnell garage or North-east entrance to the Front Street garage. A section along McConnell Blvd. is maintained as a drop-off site for guests with special needs. For general Accessibility info, CLICK HERE .

evidence.heading: We do not accept:

evidence.heading: Metal Detection Devices
evidence.text: In light of recent world events, we have opted to take additional measures in our effort to increase public safety within our venue. Along with the enforcement of bag size limits that have recently been introduced, effective immediately, we will be implementing the use of metal detection devices at all venue entrances for all events. evidence.heading: Scanning a Ticket at the Ballpark
evidence.text: Quickly access your tickets in the MLB Ballpark app via the "Home" tab for your next upcoming game by tapping “Open Tickets”, which will take you directly to your ticket barcode(s) so you can quickly scan to enter at entrance gates. If you have more than one ticket, this view will default to your first ticket, and you can swipe left to view additional tickets in the carousel. You will need to scan each ticket on your device at the gate or else digitally forward additional tickets to others in your party.

evidence.heading: Scanning a Ticket at the Ballpark

If you have more than one ticket, this view will default to the first ticket, and you can swipe left to view and tap additional tickets in the carousel. You will need to tap each ticket on your device at the gate or else digitally forward additional tickets to others in your party.

evidence.heading: Scanning a Ticket at the Ballpark
evidence.text: You can also access your tickets from the “Tickets” tab, “Wallet” section. Simply tap on the Event card or click “Open Tickets”, which will display a list of your tickets. From the list view, tap “Open” to see the "Scan View" of your ticket for display at ballpark entrance gates. This view will display your event information, seating information, and account information. If you have multiple tickets or parking passes, you can swipe through them in "Scan View". You will need to scan each ticket on your device at the gate or else digitally forward additional tickets to others in your party.

evidence.heading: Guest Guide A-to-Z
evidence.text: ADA SEATING & EXCHANGE POLICY All wheelchair spaces and companion seating are assigned unless in General Admission seating. Seats may be purchased in advance by phone through SeatGeek at 888-983-1783. Guests may pre-arrange special wheelchair needs by calling Providence Park at 503.553.5550 to schedule an escort to/from their seating location. Providence Park meets all ADA requirements. The Providence Park ADA exchange policy facilitates making ADA seats available for ADA qualified patrons who possess a ticket for an inaccessible seat. If a ticket holder requires ADA seating for a home game(s) they should notify their Member Services Rep or the Member Services Department ( members@timbers.com ) to arrange for relocation into ADA seating. Please be aware that the relocation of these seats is based solely upon ticket availability, therefore advance notice is beneficial. evidence.text: Champions Plaza and the Champions Moment Monument, located outside Gate 4, celebrates the 2005 World Series Champion White Sox and our fans. The diamond-shaped plaza consists of a limited number of bricks inscribed with personalized fan messages (Bricks are no longer available for purchase) , surrounded by engraved pavers commemorating great moments and players in White Sox history. The granite and bronze sculpture that stands at the heart of the plaza depicts and highlights key plays, players and moments of the team's amazing march through October of the Championship 2005 season. The plaza and sculpture were unveiled in April 2008.

evidence.heading: Does the stadium have accessibility services?
evidence.text: Yes. The Riyadh Air Metropolitano has services and dedicated spaces for people with reduced mobility, reserved parking spaces (with advance booking and an accreditation card) and specific support through the Atlético Customer Service Office. We recommend planning your arrival in advance and following the instructions of the organising staff at all times.

Some of the most accessible are the intercity buses on lines 286, 288, 211, 212, 256, 827 and the night line N204. Also the EMT —city— buses with daytime lines 4, 28, 38, 48, 140, 153, 165, 167 and E2, and return night lines N5 and N6.
You can also reach the venue by VTC and taxi, with designated stops and pick-up points at the exit with direct access to the M-40. It is also accessible on foot and by bicycle.

The Riyadh Air Metropolitano has services and dedicated spaces to make it easier for people with reduced mobility to attend, with the aim of ensuring a comfortable, safe and accessible experience during the events held at the stadium.
People who need specific assistance or additional information about accessibility can contact the Atlético Customer Service Office in advance.
The venue has parking spaces reserved for people with reduced mobility. To use them, you must request a reservation in advance and present the corresponding accreditation card.

evidence.heading: Bag Policy & Bag Drop
evidence.text: Stanford Athletics has implemented a Clear Bag Policy for all athletics events. This policy limits the size and types of bags that are permitted inside athletic venues. Approved bags include clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC bags that do not exceed 12”x6”x12” and small clutch bags or purses no larger than 4.5” x 6.5” (approximately the size of a hand with or without a handle or a strap. Click here to learn more about the Clear Bag Policy. Fans can leave their bags at designated Bag Drop locations around the facility, located at Sunken Diamond and at the north end of Stanford Stadium near Gate 10. Bag Drop locations open 30 minutes before gates open at Stanford Stadium, and will remain open until 1 hour after the game concludes.

evidence.heading: Before You Go: NC State Game Day Guide
evidence.text: We can't wait for you to join us under the lights this Friday, Oct. 23, as the Cardinal takes on NC State, presented by Acer. Gates open at 6 PM PT, with kickoff set for 7:30 PM PT Before heading to campus on Saturday, check out our Game Day Central page, your one-stop shop to prepare you for game day. From stadium and parking information to an A-Z guide tackling all your questions, get familiar with Game Day Central to maximize your fun on The Farm! Be sure to share this page with others in your group.

evidence.heading: ADA Shuttle Service
evidence.text: Stanford Athletics will provide ADA shuttle service on game days for fans who need assistance traveling to and from Stanford Stadium. Motorized carts will pick up guests at select locations near the stadium and drop them off primarily at Gate 4. Service will begin 30 minutes prior to gates opening. After the game, carts will be lined up outside Gate 4 and transport guests to select drop-off locations. Click here for a map of pick-up and drop-off locations.

evidence.heading: Ticket Office Location and Hours
evidence.text: The Athletics Ticket Office is located at Gate 2 of Stanford Stadium. The Ticket Office opens 3 hours prior to kickoff on game days as well as 9 AM PT - 4 PM PT, Monday through Friday. evidence.heading: Buck/Cardinal Club Hospitality Area

Located at the north end of the stadium on the outer concourse between gates 5 and 10, the hospitality space is open when gates open until kickoff, and reopens for 20 minutes during halftime.

evidence.heading: Skybox Access

evidence.text: Parking at Sportsman's Park is available for both pre-sold permit holders and single-game visitors. Refer to your permit for the designated lot entry point for a smooth parking experience. The Black Lot is designated for day-of parking convenience for visitors without pre-sold permits.

Visit the Arizona Cardinals Team Store at State Farm Stadium, open year-round with convenient operating hours from Monday to Saturday, 10AM to 6PM. On game days, the store welcomes guests at 9AM, but entry is exclusive to ticket holders upon stadium gate opening. Locate the Cardinals Team Store at two accessible points: the Plaza near Gate 2 or the Main Concourse across from Section 132.

For added peace of mind, parents are invited to visit any of our conveniently located Guest Services Booths to obtain a Child Safety Wristband. These wristbands allow parents to write down their child's ticket location or a contact phone number in case of separation. Find Guest Services Booths along the Main Concourse at Gate 1, Gate 2, and Gate 3, as well as on the Upper Concourse at Sections 417 & 448.

Elevators are conveniently located near the three (3) public entrances and two (2) Gila River Casinos Club Entrances for the convenience of our guests. Priority usage of these elevators is granted to individuals with disabilities.
BetMGM Gate 1 : Provides access to all levels. Please note, this elevator may experience brief holds during pregame, halftime, and postgame periods for team movements.
Hyundai Gate 2 : Offers access to all levels.
Bud Light Gate 3 : Allows access to all levels.

State Farm Stadium features escalators near the three (3) public entrances and two (2) Gila River Casinos Club Entrances. Those at Gates 1 & 3 lead to the Club Level and Terrace Concourse, while Gate 2 provides access to the Terrace Concourse only. Elevators at Gila River Casinos Club West and Gila River Casinos Club East are reserved for Club and Loft ticket holders, granting access to the Club Level. During Cardinals games, escalators run upwards in the first half and downwards in the second to aid exit efficiency.
Entry Process & Ticketing for Children: Children under 24 months old may enter without a ticket but need a "lap pass" obtained at the entrance gates.

For NFL games, stadium gates will open two hours before kickoff. Gate opening times for major events and concerts at State Farm Stadium may vary; please consult the event listing page for specific details.

During Arizona Cardinals games, open captioning is provided below the stadium's north and south video boards. Complimentary smartphones with open captioning are available at Gate 1 Guest Services (across from Section 104). For further inquiries before game day, contact the Cardinals Ticket Office at (602) 379-0102 or email askquestions@cardinals.nfl.net .

Guests with limited mobility or in wheelchairs who require special seating can exchange their tickets for appropriate seats at the Ticket Office before entry or at Guest Services booths at Gates 1, 2, and 3. Limited availability, first-come, first-served basis.

The State Farm Stadium Ticket Office, situated on the North side, operates from Monday to Friday, 10 AM to 6 PM, and opens before major events. Kindly note that the Ticket Office does not accept cash payments. Secure your tickets for all stadium events by visiting SeatGeek.com.

Please be aware that reselling event tickets, regardless of the price, is strictly prohibited within State Farm Stadium and Sportsman’s Park. Tickets acquired from sources other than the State Farm Stadium Ticket Office, the Arizona Cardinals, or SeatGeek are done so at your own risk. State Farm Stadium and the Arizona Cardinals assume no responsibility for invalid tickets and will not issue replacements or refunds for tickets purchased through secondary providers.

State Farm Stadium Ticket Office is your one-stop destination for securing tickets to the hottest events in town! Conveniently located next to Gate 2 on the north side of the stadium, our knowledgeable and enthusiastic team is here to assist you with all your ticketing needs.

At State Farm Stadium, we prioritize accessibility. If you need ADA seating, we're here to help. Purchase ADA seats with up to three companion seats. Contact our Box Office for assistance. Availability varies, so reach out for personalized help.

evidence.heading: ADA / Accessibility
evidence.text: On Cardinals game days vehicles must have a valid Cardinals parking hangtag to enter Sportsman’s Park or offsite gameday parking areas. A valid state-issued hangtag or license plate is required to park in a signed ADA spot. Please contact the Arizona Cardinals Ticket Office at (602) 379-0102 for more information on gameday ADA parking.

evidence.heading: ADA / Accessibility
evidence.text: State Farm Stadium provides open captioning service for the stadium public address system. Open captioning is displayed below the stadium’s North and South video boards. Open captioning is automatically provided for larger sporting events that utilize the stadium’s public address system including Arizona Cardinals games and the Fiesta Bowl. In addition, open captioning is available via smartphones which are available free of charge at the Gate 1 Guest Services Office located across from Section 104. For more information in advance of a Cardinals game day, please contact the Cardinals Ticket Office at (602) 379-0102 or by e-mail at askquestions@cardinals.nfl.net . For smaller sporting events that utilize the public address system open captioning is available by request. To request open captioning, or to consult with stadium staff about appropriate communication aids/services, please contact our Guest Services Department at 623-433-7015 or email guestservices@statefarmstadium.com . Requests for open captioning should be made a minimum of two (2) weeks prior to the event.

evidence.heading: ADA / Accessibility
evidence.text: State Farm Stadium is equipped to offer smartphone open captioning for guests. Smartphone open captioning is automatically provided for larger sporting events that utilize the stadium’s public address system including Arizona Cardinals games and the Fiesta Bowl. Smartphones for open captioning use are available free of charge at the Gate 1 Guest Service Office across from section 104. Fans will be asked to leave a valid driver’s license or another form of identification when checking out an open caption smartphone. For more information in advance of Cardinals game days, please contact the Cardinals Ticket Office at 602-379-0102 or via e-mail at askquestions@cardinals.nfl.net . For information regarding smartphone usage at non-Cardinals events call 623-433-7015 or email guestservices@statefarmstadium.com .

For guests in need of ADA seating, our ticketing system allows the purchase of an ADA seat along with up to three (3) companion seats in the same row, contiguous with the ADA seat. Reach out to our Box Office for assistance or inquiries.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Target Field. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.

evidence.heading: Entry Guidelines
evidence.text: Prohibited Items: For the general safety of all guests the following items are not allowed into Target Field: ball retrievers, balloons, bats, beach balls, boom boxes, brooms, fireworks, flasks, Frisbees, coolers, inflatables, laser pointers, lawn chairs, noise-making devices, weapons, wooden sticks, or rods. Small whiskbrooms and small souvenir bats are permitted. Prior to entering the ballpark, guests will have the option of: surrendering the item at the gate, leaving and then returning without the prohibited item, or storing the item in a locker outside Gate 6. Surrendered items will not be returned to guests.

evidence.heading: Bag Storage
evidence.text: Prohibited bags may be securely stored at no charge during Twins home games. The bag storage area is located near Gate 6 and Target Field Station. Please note, all bags will be searched prior to being stored.

evidence.heading: Bicycle Parking
evidence.text: The Minnesota Twins encourage guests to ride their bicycle to Target Field. There is a secure, staffed bike corral located near Gate 6 and Target Field Station, and guests are encouraged to store their bike in this area. There is no charge for this service. For more information, visit twins.com/transportation .

evidence.heading: MyTwins Season Ticket Member Entrances
evidence.text: MyTwins Reserved, Choice, and Flex Season Ticket Members and their guests have access to two exclusive entrances, located at Gate 34 and Target Field Station. Present your digital MyTwins Membership digital ID card and skip the lines to gain quicker access to Target Field.

evidence.heading: Concessions
evidence.text: There are three restaurants located at Target Field. Hrbek’s is in the home-plate area of the Main Concourse, near Gate 14 and Section 114. Truly On Deck is in the right-field corner area of the Club Concourse, near Gate 34. The Keeper’s Heart Town Ball Tavern is located in the left-field corner area of the Club Concourse, between Section V and Section 229. All 3 of these restaurants are open to all guests and are fully wheelchair accessible.

evidence.heading: ATMs and Reverse ATM’s
evidence.text: Target Field has one traditional U.S. Bank ATM located on the Main Concourse in the elevator lobby near Section 112. Please note, concessions and retail locations at Target Field do not accept cash. Target Field also has five reverse ATM’s, which can be used to load cash onto pre-paid debit cards. These are located on the Main Concourse inside Gate 29 and in the elevator lobby near Gate 3; on the Treasure Island Home Run Deck near Section 231; and on the Terrace Concourse near the top of both the Right Field and Left Field escalators. There is no transaction fee to use the reverse ATM’s.

evidence.heading: Carbliss Clubhouse
evidence.text: The Carbliss Clubhouse is a lounge located in the left field corner at Target Field, near section 127 and Gate 6. The Carbliss Clubhouse has several monitors so guests can follow the Twins and other Major League Baseball games. The lounge has tiered standing-room drink rails facing the field, several high-top tables, and a cabana-style seating area. The entire area also featuees overhead radiant heaters.

evidence.heading: Drop-Off Zone
evidence.text: Guests with limited mobility may use either of the Drop Off Zones along 7th Street, near both the New Era Team Store and Gate 14. No accessible parking permit is required to use these Drop-Off Zones, but these are strictly drop off zones with no parking permitted in either zone.

evidence.heading: Elevators
evidence.text: There are 13 public elevators located throughout Target Field. Elevators 1 & 2 are in the Administrative Office building near Gate 6. Elevators 3 & 4 are located across from Section 125. Elevators 6 & 7 are located across from Section 112. Elevators 9-12 are located across from Section 103. Elevator 13 is located across from Section 133, and elevator 14 is located at Gate 3. Elevator T1 is located near the entrance to Truly On Deck.

evidence.heading: Aerosols and Self-Defense Sprays
evidence.text: Aerosols and Self-Defense Sprays may not be carried into Target Field. These items may be stored for free at any entry gate and picked-up at that same gate upon leaving Target Field.

evidence.text: If you need to bring a large bag, you will need to leave it at our bag storage facility just outside the main entrance at a cost of £10 per bag .
Get 4 hours free parking when you spend £35 or more at Outlet Shopping at The O2. Simply show your receipts at The Welcome Desk at the main entrance or the Parking Office located by Car Park 1.

Leave your keys with us and we will park your car at the VIP entrance. Valet parking opens 2 hours before event doors open. Your car will be back and ready to go as soon as the show finishes. Pre-booked Valet is £75, or £85 if you book on the day. Valet parking is available only for The O2 arena events.

If you need to bring a large bag, you will need to leave it at our bag storage facility just outside the main entrance at a cost of £10 per bag. Your American Express Card gets you a complimentary bag drop. Join the Amex® Cardmember lane and drop your bag before your show, at no cost.
Head to the entrance that is stated on your ticket and join one of the queues. ​
Security checks take place at the main entrance of indigo at The O2.
If you’ve got a ticket for accessible seating, you can use any entrance. The main concourse are level and step-free and there are accessible lifts across all levels.
If you are unable to queue, talk to a member of staff at the arena entrance, they'll sort priority entry for you as soon as the doors open.

If you need a wheelchair, call 0208 463 2211 once the event doors open, and we’ll bring a wheelchair to you at the main entrance. If you require this service, you'll need to bring someone to escort you around the venue including operating the wheelchair. Please note this number is only staffed on an event night.

There is also a Changing place unit on Level 1. These toilets are larger, have a height adjustable changing bench, a hoist and room for up to two Personal Assistants. If you need to use a Changing Place unit on a non-event day, this is located near Entrance H.
Allow extra time during peak events for getting in and out

evidence.heading: What time does the Box Office open?
evidence.text: The Box Office is only open on show days. You can purchase tickets in person directly via our box office or purchase tickets online any time at LiveNation.com. Box Office typically open 2 hours before gates open.

evidence.heading: Where and when should I arrive?
evidence.text: Parking will generally open 2 hours prior to our scheduled gate time. All entry times are subject to change. We recommend arriving early to reduce the heavy traffic and wait times prior to events.

evidence.heading: What time do gates open?
evidence.text: Gate times vary, but are usually 60 minutes prior to show time. Please check the specific event page as these dates are subject to change. Please do not attempt to enter the venue any earlier than the designated times as you will be turned around and told to return when the parking lots open.

evidence.heading: Can I bring a service animal?
evidence.text: If your service animal needs access to a relief area, please contact a member of the Guest Services team. You will be directed to exit and re-enter the venue with their assistance.

evidence.heading: Where and when should I arrive?
evidence.text: You'll find us at 665 Route 18, Burgettstown PA 15021. Parking will generally open 2 hours prior to our scheduled gate time. All entry times are subject to change. We recommend arriving early to reduce the heavy traffic and wait times prior to events.

evidence.heading: If I leave the venue, can I come back in?
evidence.text: No re-entry permitted.

PICK UP/DROP OFFS : When dropping off a guest(s), stay in the far LEFT LANE when you arrive. The parking staff will direct you to the Drop Off area at the entrance ramp. If you are arriving in an Uber/Lyft, please notify the parking attendants so they may direct the vehicle to the designated Uber/Lyft area.
BOX OFFICE : Open two hours before gates open and is only open on show days.

evidence.heading: Parking
evidence.text: Start your concert experience the moment you arrive. Reserve parking ahead of time for a hassle-free entrance and a seamless night at The Pavilion at Star Lake.

evidence.heading: PREMIUM PARKING OPTIONS
evidence.text: Reserved Parking: Our best parking spaces, all within close walking distance to the venue entrance with expedited exit after the show. Autos only - no oversized vehicles.

evidence.heading: Accommations
evidence.text: If you have questions or need assistance we have a table staffed with customer service employees to help answer questions related to seating or other accommodations. These stations are located at our East and West Gate entrances. All venue concession stands, restrooms, merchandise stands are accessible.

evidence.heading: Venue App
evidence.text: Is there an official venue app? Yes! The official Utilita Arena Birmingham app is now available on the App Store and Google Play. It is currently being rolled out for selected events to help you manage tickets and plan your visit. If you have been contacted by your ticket agent and advised to download the venue app, please visit our Venue App Guide for a full walkthrough on how to set up your account and access your tickets. How do I know if the venue app is available for my event? If the app is active for your show, you will receive an email before your visit with specific instructions. You can also check the dedicated event page on our website; if the event is mobile-only via the app, it will be clearly stated there. How do I access my tickets in the venue app? To view your tickets, simply download the app and create an account using the exact same email address you used to purchase your tickets. Once logged in, tap 'Retrieve My Tickets' and link your AXS account. Email Match: If you used a different email address by mistake, please delete the app account and re-register with the correct one. Troubleshooting: If your tickets still don't appear, you can access them via the AXS app, contact AXS Support for assistance. or visit the venue Box Office on the night with your order confirmation and photo ID. Please note that a £2.00 fee per ticket will apply for this service. For a step-by-step visual guide, please visit our Venue App Guide .

evidence.heading: Accessible Parking and Arrival
evidence.text: Where is accessible parking located? Accessible parking is available on parking deck 4, with elevator access to the Arena’s main entrance. The maximum height of the parking garage is 2 m. If you arrive in a vehicle, displaying a disabled parking permit, that exceeds the height limit of the parking garage, please contact the traffic controller on the arena deck upon arrival. The traffic controller will guide you to the right parking space. Security staff will assist with outdoor mobility if needed and guide you to the best route. Note that the route to the Veturitie bus stop via Veturitie is not accessible.

evidence.heading: Where is accessible parking located?
evidence.text: Accessible parking is available on parking deck 4, with elevator access to the Arena’s main entrance. The maximum height of the parking garage is 2 m.

evidence.heading: How do I book tickets to Veikkaus Arena events?
evidence.text: Open on event days, the Veikkaus Arena ticket office is located at the upper entrance of the venue. The ticket office typically opens about an hour before doors open.

evidence.heading: Is there a cloakroom at Veikkaus Arena?
evidence.text: Lockers are located on the 1st floor (near the main entrances and stand 108), on the 3rd floor (near the main entrances and stand 318), and in Stairwell C, near the entrance to the floor level (permanto).

evidence.heading: How have you taken inclusivity into consideration at your events?
evidence.text: On the first floor, near the main entrance, you’ll find the Safe Space, designed to support fans who think or experience things differently. During events, trained staff are present in the room, which features comfortable seating, weighted blankets, and headphones.

evidence.heading: Cloakroom
evidence.text: Is there a cloakroom at Veikkaus Arena? Veikkaus Arena offers paid storage lockers in three different sizes. The cost ranges from €5 to €12 (plus a €0.95 service fee), depending on the size of the locker. You can pay for the locker via your mobile device or by using a payment card at an on-site payment terminal. Tip! The quickest way to access a locker is by scanning the QR code displayed on the wall. Lockers are located on the 1st floor (near the main entrances and stand 108), on the 3rd floor (near the main entrances and stand 318), and in Stairwell C, near the entrance to the floor level (permanto). If your payment for the Mobile Lockers fails, please check with your bank or card issuer to ensure there are no restrictions on your card that prevent international online payments.

evidence.heading: Inclusivity
evidence.text: How have you taken inclusivity into consideration at your events? Gender-neutral restrooms are located near seating sections 110 and 111. On the first floor, near the main entrance, you’ll find the Safe Space, designed to support fans who think or experience things differently. During events, trained staff are present in the room, which features comfortable seating, weighted blankets, and headphones. Our staff is trained to handle harassment situations, so if you encounter unwanted behavior, please do not hesitate to contact the Safe Space team or any of our employees. Veikkaus Arena enforces zero tolerance for all forms of harassment, bullying, discrimination, violence, and abuse of power.

evidence.heading: Legazy

evidence.heading: STORAGE LOCKERS
evidence.text: Lockers are located on the 1st floor near the main entrance and section 108, on the 3rd floor near the main entrance and section 318, as well as in staircase C near the floor entrance. If you experience any issues when paying for Mobile Lockers, please check with your bank or card issuer that international online transactions are enabled on your card.

evidence.heading: When is the box office open?
evidence.text: Standard Hours: The box office at Madison Square Garden is open Monday through Saturday from 12:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m. and is closed on Sunday. Additional Hours: On all event days, the box office at Madison Square Garden will remain open until one hour after the event begins. If there is an event on Sunday, the box office will be open from noon until one hour after the event begins. Please note, additional box office hours may vary. Please note, tickets for new events are available in person at the box office beginning the day after the general public on sale, with the exception of Sundays. Tickets for new events that go on sale to the general public on a Saturday will be available in person at the box office beginning on Monday. Madison Square Garden accepts credit/debit cards or mobile payment, including Google Pay and Apple Pay. If you would like to make a purchase with cash, a reverse ATM, which converts cash into a debit card, is available for your convenience.

evidence.heading: How do I register my wristband?
evidence.text: Download the Coachella Mobile App ( Apple Store | Google Play ) to register your wristband. Registration will open once orders start shipping out. Registering your wristband unlocks surprises, secures your investment, helps replace your lost or stolen wristband* and helps with a smooth entrance to the festival. *Fees may apply. Unique email address required for each Wristband registration. Only register the wristband you are wearing. Enter your legal first and last name. Enter the six letter code located on the back of your wristband. Registration can only be done ONE time, no changes. Please note, upon registering it will say: âYour wristband has been registeredâ, and show a check mark. Then you click on the âcompleteâ button and that screen goes away. There is no follow up confirmation email or text. Reach out to AXS order support for wristband registration issues. DO NOT: Register wristbands for other people. Register a wristband using your nickname (ID may be requested).

evidence.heading: How a Boston Club Birthed the Newport Jazz Festival in 1954
evidence.text: And as good as it was going, it was about to get better. One night shortly after opening, the Louis Armstrong All Stars were playing Symphony Hall and Wein tasked pianist and former member of Armstrong’s band Sidney Catlett with getting them to stop by after the gig. And stop by they did. Louis Armstrong made a dramatic impromptu entrance before jumping on stage to sing “When It’s Sleepy Time Down South.” Wein and Storyville had catapulted to a new level.

Once you arrive at the festival, you may pick up your wristband at the Accessibility Hub. Registering for a wristband also allows you to add one additional person in your party to have a wristband during your time at the festival.

evidence.heading: WHAT IS ALLOWED?
evidence.text: Kindness Sunscreen Empty refillable water bottles to use at refillable water stations Soft-sided coolers Bags under 20”x20”x10” Blankets 6’x8’ or smaller Strollers/wagons/carts are only allowed for patrons attending with children 9 years old and younger who must be present with you at time of entry Chairs under 34” high Chairs under 30″ high are allowed outside of the no-chair zones. Chairs 30-34” high should be set up farthest from the stage or in designated shade areas. No recliners or footrests are allowed. If your chair has a shade cover, it must be left in the down position. Personal shade tents will be allowed. Please use your personal judgement to make sure your tent does not impede on others. Space is first come first serve at the back of the performance areas. Canes and similar mobility assistance devices like trekking sticks are permitted as long as there are no metal points protruding from bottom, or concealed. Personal umbrellas in the event of rain, but must be closed during performances Point-and-shoot cameras are permitted, but cannot be used to reproduce the event and must not interfere with other fans’ enjoyment of the event. Be present! Medications and prescriptions Over the counter medications are allowed. If you bring prescription medication, please bring a valid photo ID that matches the name printed on your prescription.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Burning Man, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

evidence.heading: Storage Area Safety and Security
evidence.text: The fire extinguisher must be placed 8 ft. – 10 ft. from the fuel storage area where it is visible and easily accessible.

evidence.heading: Can I camp next to my car?
evidence.text: You can and you should keep your vehicle at your campsite. You may not use it for transport around our city. Black Rock City is fully accessible by bicycle or on foot.

evidence.heading: What kind of facilities do you provide for those in a wheelchair?
evidence.text: We are wheelchair friendly , and provide several wheelchair accessible bathrooms.

evidence.heading: What kind of facilities do you provide for those in a wheelchair?
evidence.text: Additionally, you can contact wheelchairs@burningman.com with questions.

evidence.heading: What’s the best way to get around?
evidence.text: We encourage you to decorate your transportation. You may not drive your car at the event. This is a serious safety issue – moving cars create large clouds of dust, reducing visibility dramatically. Please recognize the importance of this rule. The sole exceptions for this are Mutant Vehicles and vehicles for people with accessibility needs. If you would like to bring your Mutant Vehicle art car to Black Rock City, see the Mutant Vehicle Licensing and Criteria . You will need to apply and then register with the Black Rock City DMV (Department of Mutant Vehicles) dmv@burningman.com . If you have a accessibility need and need a vehicle to get around Black Rock City, see the Vehicles for people with accessibility needs page. For more information read through the Vehicles at Burning Man section of this web site.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Essence Festival of Culture. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

evidence.heading: Accessibility (ADA)
evidence.text: Should a patron need to exchange their seating for wheelchair and companion seating on the day of the game they are attending, they may do so, subject to availability, at the Saints ticket box office at Gate A Ground. Please be advised such exchanges and relocations are accommodated on a first come, first served basis. If seating is available for an exchange, a comparable seating location will be offered. If no comparable seating remains, patron may be offered an upgraded seat location, however, the patron will be responsible for paying the difference for the upgrade should they choose to make the exchange. Patrons can also inquire about relocations at Gate F Lobby on the Plaza Level once inside the stadium. On non-Saints games, please proceed to the Guest Relations Center near Gate F on the Plaza Level (interior on the concourse). Please note, relocations are handled by the Saints on game days.

evidence.heading: Accessibility (ADA)
evidence.text: The Caesars Superdome Box Office is a walk-up service only. For more information, please call 504-587-3822.

evidence.heading: Accessibility (ADA)
evidence.text: The Superdome has a no re-entry policy. In the event a guest needs to exit and return for any reason, the guest should be referred to the Experience Ambassador (or alternatively the Ticket Supervisor) assigned to the particular gate, who will then approve the guest exiting and returning if the situation warrants same. Examples of such situations include medical emergencies (e.g., forgot needed medication) and permitting a service animal to exit to relieve itself.

evidence.heading: Parking
evidence.text: For patrons with accessible parking needs, the Wisconsin Athletic Ticket Office will sell permits in levels 1-4 of Lot 17 (1525 Engineering Drive; North of Camp Randall Stadium) on a single game basis. Permits will go on-sale (phone sales only) through the UW Athletic Ticket Office at 1-800-462-2343 or 608-262-1440 the Monday before each home game starting at 8:30 a.m. Should a holiday fall on the Monday preceding a home game, permit sales will take place on the first open day of business thereafter, usually the next day. Permits will cost $20. Limit will be one permit per account. Lot 17 accessible parking permits will be delivered as mobile parking permits sent to the email address on file with the purchasing patron. Prior to arriving to campus, patrons should add their mobile parking permit to their mobile wallet (Apple Wallet for iPhones or Google Pay for Androids). Having the mobile parking permit added to the mobile wallet eliminates the need for Wi-Fi in a location of high cell phone usage to access the mobile parking permit via the Badgers App or email. Patrons should have their Lot 17 accessible parking permit and accessible parking placard (or accessible parking license plates) displayed to the lot attendant upon their arrival to Lot 17. Additional parking information can be found on UWBadgers.com/parking .

evidence.heading: iTHINK Financial Amphitheatre Venue Information
evidence.text: The iTHINK Financial Amphitheatre, formerly known as Coral Sky Amphitheatre, Cruzan Amphitheatre, and Perfect Vodka Amphitheatre, is a modern open-air venue owned by the South Florida Fair & Palm Beach County Expositions, Inc., and operated by Live Nation. Since its inception in 1996, it has been a cornerstone of South Florida’s live music scene, hosting genres from rock to country and festivals like Lilith Fair and Crüe Fest. Located at the South Florida Fairgrounds, the venue offers a capacity of 20,000, with 8,000 reserved seats under a roof and a sprawling lawn for up to 12,000 guests. It features state-of-the-art lighting and sound systems, multiple concession stands, YETI water refill stations, and recycling bins to promote sustainability. The venue is cashless, accepting only credit, debit, or mobile payments like Apple Pay and Google Pay. Accessibility is a priority, with ADA-compliant seating, restrooms, and parking, plus assisted listening devices available upon request. Guests can access two main entrances (North and South Gates), a Fast Lane gate for passholders, and a VIP entry for VIP clients. For assistance, Guest Services is located in the North Plaza, reachable by text at 561-536-3822 or email at [email protected] .

evidence.heading: A-Z Guide: Vaught-Hemingway Stadium
evidence.text: Whether you're planning your trip to Vaught-Hemingway Stadium, walking up to the gate or settling in to your seat, we hope you have a wonderful visit. Use this A-to-Z guide to answer many of the questions you may have about a game day in Oxford.

evidence.heading: A
evidence.text: ACCESSIBILITY – Patrons must have a reserved ticket designated for ADA seating areas. For ADA seating tickets, contact the Ole Miss Ticket Office at 888-REB-TKTS. – The ADA elevator is located on the east side of Vaught-Hemingway Stadium near gates 13 and 14. – ADA restrooms are available in locations nearest to wheelchair accessible seating areas (North Endzone, Upper East and Lower East near Section K). – Only certified service animals are permitted inside Vaught-Hemingway Stadium and must remain on a leash or harness at all times.

evidence.heading: A
evidence.text: ADA – Patrons must have a reserved ticket designated for ADA seating areas. ADA tickets are available through the online sale only. – ADA elevators are located on the east side of Vaught- Hemingway Stadium near gates 13 and 14. – ADA restrooms are available in locations nearest to wheelchair accessible seating areas (North Endzone, Upper East and Lower East near Section K). – Only certified service animals are permitted inside Vaught-Hemingway Stadium and must remain on a leash or harness at all times.

evidence.heading: A
evidence.text: ADA PARKING – Fans must have a valid Ole Miss gameday parking pass AND a state-issued ADA credential to park in ADA stalls during athletics events. – Fans must display a state-issued ADA parking credential any time you park in stalls marked with ADA signage on the Ole Miss Campus and off-campus shuttle lots. – Violators are subject to citation and tow. – All ADA signage and markings are honored 24 hours a day, 7 days a week on the Ole Miss campus and off-campus shuttle lots. Please do not park in an ADA stall when parking for athletics events unless you have a state-issued ADA hang tag or license plate along with your gameday parking pass. – The Americans with Disabilities Act prohibits the refusal of service to any patron seeking service. Therefore, fans are asked to be courteous to those requiring service and to not use the ADA shuttles unless needed. – ADA Golf Carts are located on the Southeast and Northeast sides of the stadium. – If you need assistance for a shuttle, please call 662-915-7235.

evidence.heading: A
evidence.text: ADA ON-CAMPUS GOLF CART SHUTTLES – On-campus golf cart shuttle service begins at 7 AM – On-campus golf cart shuttle service ends 1 hour post game – On-campus golf cart shuttle stops at Vaught-Hemingway Stadium are found outside the northeast and northwest corners of the stadium. These stops will provide golf cart shuttles to/from the South Lot/Lot E and Tad Smith Coliseum. – In order to accommodate ADA fans waiting at ADA tents, on-campus golf cart shuttles are restricted from picking up patrons to/from ADA Tents. – On-campus golf cart shuttles are courtesy shuttles that will take those requiring assistance to assigned stops across campus. – On-campus golf cart shuttles will not transport coolers, tents and other tailgating equipment unless associated with an ADA guest. – On-campus ADA shuttles are intended to service fans on gameday who need assistance and their party. They are not intended to provide transportation for all fans. The Americans with Disabilities Act prohibits the refusal of service to any patron seeking service. Therefore, fans are asked to be courteous to those requiring service and to not use the ADA shuttles unless needed.

evidence.heading: A

No exceptions. – A valid ID is required for every sale. – Limit two (2) drinks per transaction. – No sales or service to visibly intoxicated persons. – Underaged drinking is prohibited. – Purchasing or providing alcohol to minors is prohibited. – Guests who violate this policy may be ejected and risk arrest and loss of ticket privileges. – Sales will start when the gates or doors open. – Sales will end at the conclusion of the 3rd quarter

Entrances: All entrances to buildings and theaters are accessible. Elevators operate between the Lexus Red Parking and main entrances for the Margot and Bill Winspear Opera House, as well as the Lexus Silver Parking and the Dee and Charles Wyly Theatre. Elevators operate within theaters between the orchestra, terrace and upper levels. Note : Patrons attending a show at the Wyly Theatre should park in Lexus Silver and take the secure tunnel from the parking area directly to the lobby.

Door to Seat Service: Our friendly ushers are available starting one hour before performances begin to assist patrons from the front of the building to the theaters. At the theater, ushers are available to assist patrons to their seats or wheelchair-accessible locations. Mobility aids that cannot be stored safely within the patron’s seating area and wheelchairs for patrons who transfer to a theater seat will be stored outside the theater, as close as possible to patron’s seat. At intermission, ushers will make every effort to check in with patrons who need assistance getting to restroom entrances or intermission bars. At the conclusion of the performance, ushers will be available to help patrons to the elevator banks or the front of the building.

The Lexus Silver Parking is located below Moody Performance Hall. Its entrance is directly across (east) Jack Evans Street from the Wyly Theatre.

Your personal information is contained behind secured networks and is only accessible by a limited number of persons who have special access rights to such systems, and are required to keep the information confidential. When you place orders or access your personal information, we offer the use of a secure server. All sensitive/credit information you supply is transmitted via Secure Socket Layer (SSL) technology and then encrypted into our databases to be only accessed as stated above.

evidence.heading: Visitors with disa­bilities
evidence.text: We are committed to ensuring that visitors with disabilities can fully enjoy their visit to the Hallenstadion. We have set out the key information for a barrier-free experience here.

evidence.heading: Entrances
evidence.text: Both main entrances have separate access for wheelchair users and visitors with impaired mobility. These lead you into the foyer on Level 0, which is completely wheelchair accessible.

evidence.heading: Wheelchair spaces
evidence.text: Wheelchair spaces are located on the southeast and southwest sides of the Arena, with a first-class view of the stage. They are accessible via the main entrances at ground level and also come with an additional space for an accompanying person. Disabled toilets are located nearby.

evidence.heading: Tickets
evidence.text: Tickets for wheelchair spaces can only be booked directly through the organiser for the event. The Ticketing team will be happy to inform you of whom you should contact to order your tickets. For more information, please contact Ticketcorner on +41 44 316 77 88.

evidence.heading: Cloakroom / banned items
evidence.text: Yes, there is a cloakroom at all events. On the first floor (accessible from the foyer) there are self-service lockers where you can leave jackets and other items. The price is CHF 04.00 per locker and there is room for about two “normal” jackets in one locker.

evidence.heading: Cloakroom / banned items
evidence.text: In addition, the drop-off point East is open for larger items at “normal” concerts. These can be deposited here at a price of CHF 08.00.

evidence.heading: General
evidence.text: In accordance with Section 1 of the Swiss Federal Act on Protection against Passive Smoking, the Hallenstadion is classed as a publicly accessible space, so smoking is prohibited throughout the entire venue.

evidence.heading: Prohibited items / drop-off point for prohibited items
evidence.text: The following items are prohibited in the Hallenstadion:

evidence.heading: Prohibited items / drop-off point for prohibited items
evidence.text: All drinks in glass bottles, aluminum bottles (e.g. Chilly’s Bottles), cans, PET and tetra containers;

evidence.text: You can buy tickets for AFAS Dome in Antwerp on the AFAS Dome website, be•at Tickets or Ticketmaster , and with those three you know your ticket is valid.
